title: Scene Direction
description: Produced by stage 5 (directing). Per-scene cinematographic direction.

grade.description: Overall grading intent, e.g. 'warm highlights, lifted blacks, soft film grain'.

lensing.description: Optical language using Seedance's approved FOV degree anchors, depth behavior, and motion character; never equipment/lens model names.

movement_grammar.description: House rules for camera motion, e.g. 'slow push-ins on emotion, static on tension'.

shot_framing.description: The scene's OPENING shot: size, angle, subject placement — e.g. 'medium close-up, eye level, subject frame-left'.

camera_movement.description: Executable operator plan: height, distance, axis, one motivated movement idea per shot, focus behavior, and end state. Cuts/timing follow format_mode; multishot is not assumed.

format_mode.description: Least rigid Seedance control mode that still lands the scene's required beats.

first_frame.description: Visible initial composition: positions, orientation, gaze, hands/props, and motion from frame one.

location_map.description: Foreground/midground/background, camera position, light origin, and movement paths.

optics.description: Shot size and approved FOV degree per segment plus optical/motion-blur character; never millimeters.

performance.description: Observable acting: muscle behavior, eyelines, pauses, breath, listener reactions, and visible micro-realism.

physics.description: Mass, inertia, contact, fabric/fluid/particle behavior, and environmental interaction required in the shot.

white_balance_kelvin.description: Fixed scene white balance when explicitly controlled.

positive_locks.description: Short positive fixers for identity, props, geography, lighting, wardrobe, specified cuts, and continuity.

blocking.description: Who is where, facing which way; respect the 180-degree line.

sound_direction.description: Diegetic sound / ambience intent for this scene.

palette_override.description: Only if this scene deviates from the global palette — say why.

negative_notes.description: Legacy upstream avoidance notes. Prompt assembly must translate them into desired visible states in positive_locks; never submit this text raw.

transition_out.description: Directed transition into the next scene — consumed by stage 10.
